items.title: The smell around the areas and coming up through the pipes is unbearable. We jet water down our drains in the garden but it only works for a day or two. Drains overfilled across the road recently. It’s all linked the system is at least 60 years old and home extensions and other changes over the years, all permitted by local officials presumably…mean my young family are having to deal with possible health concerns and distressing odours every day

items.title: 'No Entry' sign facing the wrong way. It is the right-hand of a group of three similar signs telling drivers not to enter the upper part of Montpellier Street, Cheltenham but is actually facing the Queens Hotel (ie, eastwards), suggesting no entry to Fauconberg Road. This is likely to confuse drivers who do not know the area. It should be facing the same way as the other two 'No Entry' signs, ie roughly southwards. It may have been twisted on the post by vandals.
